cause: An isolated XDG_CONFIG_HOME hid the user MIME/browser associations; xdg-open selected dms-open.desktop instead of zen.desktop. DMS was not running.

failed_handler.message: DMS is not running. Please start DMS first.

fix: Keep desktop XDG_CONFIG_HOME unchanged when selecting a fresh DPE_PROFILE_DIR. Use Electron shell.openExternal; no custom browser launcher or Zen-specific patch.
